# OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT changelog — captured 2026-08-07
# NOTE: developers.openai.com/codex/changelog now 308-redirects to learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog

## August 2026 [NEW]
- Aug 7 — Codex CLI 0.147.0: **Agent Plugins installation with multi-catalog search**; persistent thread
  sections; automatic approval reviews via `--approve-for-me`; Cursor skill migration and Claude
  conversation synchronization; **MCP protocol 2026-07-28 support with paginated discovery**;
  web search + compaction for Amazon Bedrock. [REPORTED]
- Aug 5 — Codex CLI 0.146.1: safer automatic-review defaults for cyber-capable models; clearer
  permission-change transparency. [REPORTED alongside --approve-for-me]

## July 2026 [NEW]
- Jul 31 — GPT-5.4 / GPT-5.4 mini retiring from Codex Aug 31; migrate to **GPT-5.6-Terra** and
  **GPT-5.6-Luna**. (First appearance of GPT-5.6 model IDs on an official OpenAI docs surface —
  clears the reporting bar set on 2026-07-08.) [REPORTED]
- Jul 30 — Desktop 26.727: browser history search, multi-repository code review, refined image
  editing, new "Activity view" sidebar.
- Jul 29 — **Sign in with ChatGPT (beta)** rolling out with Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion,
  Supabase, Vercel. Live beta Aug 2. [REPORTED]
- Jul 29 — Codex CLI 0.146.0: session naming/pinning, **Agent Plugins support**, paginated thread
  history, **remote WebSocket code-mode connections**, **executor-provided skills discovery**. [REPORTED]

Plugin model (per developers.openai.com/codex/plugins): a plugin is an installable workflow bundle
packaging SKILLS + optional APP INTEGRATIONS + MCP SERVER CONFIG. Catalogs: official Plugin Directory,
repo marketplace at $REPO_ROOT/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, personal marketplace at
~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json. Shared catalog with ChatGPT.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Prior cache had no July/August entries. Four reportable items.
